constraints.name: updated-constraint
constraints.description: Updated via PATCH

constraints.name: Max dependency depth
constraints.description: Dependency chains must not exceed 5 levels deep. Excessive depth indicates architectural coupling issues.
constraints.remediation: Refactor to reduce coupling between components

constraints.name: Max dependencies per issue
constraints.description: Each issue should have at most 5 direct dependencies to maintain focus and avoid overly complex dependency chains.
constraints.remediation: Split the issue into smaller, more focused issues

constraints.name: Prohibited technology: jQuery
constraints.description: jQuery is not allowed in new code. Use native DOM APIs or the project's Vue.js framework instead.

rule.message: jQuery is prohibited

constraints.remediation: Replace jQuery usage with Vue.js reactivity or native DOM APIs

constraints.name: Prohibited technology: Webpack 4
constraints.description: Webpack 4 is deprecated. All projects must use Vite or Webpack 5+.

rule.message: Webpack 4 is deprecated, use Vite or Webpack 5+

constraints.remediation: Migrate to Vite (recommended) or Webpack 5

constraints.name: Component naming convention
constraints.description: Component aliases must be 2-4 uppercase letters (e.g., FE, BE, DB, WK). Component names must be PascalCase.

rule.message: Alias must be 2-4 uppercase letters

constraints.logic: IF NOT component.alias MATCHES '^[A-Z]{2,4}$' THEN REJECT
constraints.remediation: Rename the alias to follow the pattern (e.g., FE, BE, DB, CLI, WK)

constraints.name: Issue ID format
constraints.description: Issue IDs must follow the pattern ISS-NNN where NNN is a 3-digit zero-padded number.

rule.message: Issue ID must match ISS-NNN format

constraints.logic: IF NOT issue.id MATCHES '^ISS-\d{3}$' THEN REJECT
constraints.remediation: Use the standard ISS-NNN format for issue IDs

constraints.name: Mandatory labels
constraints.description: All issues must have at least one label for proper categorization and filtering.

rule.message: At least one label is required

constraints.remediation: Add appropriate labels to the issue (e.g., bug, feature, refactor)

constraints.name: Component ownership required
constraints.description: Every issue must be assigned to a component for proper ownership tracking and impact analysis.

rule.message: Component assignment is required

constraints.logic: IF issue.component_id IS NULL THEN REJECT
constraints.remediation: Assign the issue to an appropriate component

constraints.name: Critical issue review required
constraints.description: Critical priority issues must have at least one review before they can be closed.

rule.message: Critical issues require at least one review

constraints.logic: IF issue.priority == 'CRITICAL' AND issue.reviews < 1 THEN BLOCK_CLOSE
constraints.remediation: Get at least one review approval before closing the critical issue

constraints.name: Mandatory component assignment
constraints.description: Backend API issues must be assigned to the BE component. Frontend issues must be assigned to the FE component.

rule.message: Component should match label context

constraints.logic: IF issue.labels CONTAINS 'backend' AND issue.component_id != 'BE' THEN WARN
constraints.remediation: Assign the issue to the component matching its label context

constraints.name: Graph depth limit
constraints.description: The dependency graph must not exceed 8 levels of depth to maintain manageable architecture.

rule.message: Dependency graph exceeds maximum allowed depth

constraints.remediation: Refactor components to flatten the dependency hierarchy

constraints.name: Prohibited technology: lodash
constraints.description: Lodash is banned in new code. Use native Array methods (map, filter, reduce) or optional chaining instead.

rule.message: Lodash is prohibited, use native methods

constraints.remediation: Replace lodash with native ES6+ methods or tree-shakeable alternatives

constraints.name: Required TypeScript strict mode
constraints.description: All frontend components must be written in TypeScript with strict mode enabled. No plain .js files allowed.

rule.message: TypeScript strict mode must be enabled

constraints.remediation: Enable strict mode in tsconfig.json: { "strict": true }

constraints.name: Max issue title length
constraints.description: Issue titles must not exceed 120 characters to ensure readability in lists and dashboards.

rule.message: Title exceeds 120 characters

constraints.remediation: Shorten the title to under 120 characters

constraints.name: Required description length
constraints.description: Issues must have a description of at least 20 characters to provide sufficient context.

rule.message: Description must be at least 20 characters

constraints.remediation: Add a more detailed description to the issue

constraints.name: No direct Neo4j queries in API
constraints.description: Backend API must not contain raw Cypher queries. All database access must go through the repository pattern.

rule.message: Raw Cypher queries detected, use repository pattern

constraints.remediation: Extract Cypher queries into repository classes under src/repositories/

constraints.name: API response format
constraints.description: All API responses must follow the standard envelope format with 'data', 'error', and 'meta' fields.

rule.message: API response must follow standard envelope format

constraints.logic: IF response NOT CONTAINS 'data' AND 'error' AND 'meta' THEN REJECT
constraints.remediation: Wrap API responses in the standard envelope: { data, error, meta }

constraints.name: Max blocked issues threshold
constraints.description: No component should have more than 5 blocked issues. Excessive blockers indicate systemic problems.

rule.message: Component has too many blocked issues

constraints.remediation: Resolve blocking dependencies or refactor the component structure

constraints.name: Prohibited technology: moment.js
constraints.description: moment.js is deprecated and has a large bundle size. Use date-fns or dayjs instead.

rule.message: moment.js is deprecated, use date-fns or dayjs

constraints.remediation: Replace moment.js with date-fns (recommended) or dayjs for smaller bundle size

constraints.name: Agent working timeout
constraints.description: Issues with agent_working=true must have activity within the last 24 hours. Stale agent tasks should be unclaimed.

rule.message: Agent has been inactive for over 24 hours

constraints.logic: IF issue.agent_working == true AND issue.last_activity > 24h THEN WARN
constraints.remediation: Check agent status, reassign if the agent is stuck or timed out

constraints.name: Issue priority hierarchy
constraints.description: Issue priority must follow: CRITICAL > HIGH > MEDIUM > LOW. No custom priority values allowed.

rule.message: Invalid priority value

constraints.logic: IF issue.priority NOT IN ['CRITICAL', 'HIGH', 'MEDIUM', 'LOW'] THEN REJECT
constraints.remediation: Use one of the standard priority values: CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW

constraints.name: Status transition rules
constraints.description: Issues can only transition: OPEN → IN_PROGRESS → BLOCKED → CLOSED. No backwards transitions allowed without review.

rule.message: Invalid status transition

constraints.logic: IF issue.status_transition NOT IN allowed_transitions THEN WARN
constraints.remediation: Follow the allowed status transition flow

constraints.name: Docker image size limit
constraints.description: Docker images must not exceed 500MB. Large images slow down CI/CD and deployment pipelines.

rule.message: Docker image exceeds 500MB limit

constraints.remediation: Use multi-stage builds, alpine base images, or remove unnecessary dependencies

constraints.name: Test coverage minimum
constraints.description: Each component must maintain at least 70% test coverage. Critical paths require 90%.

rule.message: Test coverage below minimum threshold

constraints.remediation: Add unit and integration tests to reach 70% coverage minimum
